current.name: Shane L. Hogle
bio: Shane's research focuses on microbial community ecology, microbial evolution, and biogeochemistry. Shane aims to understand how microorganisms interact and evolve together, how microbial ecosystems change over time, and the consequences of these processes for ecosystem function. Work in his group links field observations and the synthesis of existing datasets with experimental manipulations of model microbial communities in the laboratory.
background: Associate Professor, Environmental and Marine Biology, Åbo Akademi University
Research Council of Finland Academy Research Fellow

current.name: Milla Similä
bio: Milla is working with both synthetic and natural plant microbiomes, aiming to predict microbial community assembly and better understand how these communities are impacted by the host and its environment.
background: M.Sc., Physiology and Genetics, University of Turku

current.name: Niina Smolander
bio: Niina is working on a project looking at the evolution of pangenomes in marine picocyanobacteria.
background: Ph.D., Physiology and Genetics, University of Turku
M.Sc., Physiology and Genetics, University of Turku
